requirement: TSK-03「使用者可以訓練並由核心生成文字。驗收：因果前綴、結束條件、採樣與 UTF-8 正確，保留語料與教師移除評估可執行。」
scope: Ticket 29 stage three: a byte-level tokenizer with a reproducible vocabulary hash, a recurrent next-token model trained on known prefixes with masked padding and unscored prefixes, seeded greedy/temperature/top-k/top-p generation with an EOS stop and a buffering UTF-8 stream decoder, source-level train/test split, teacher texts deduplicated against the test documents, and student-mode evaluation with the teacher blocked, on a three-word synthetic Chinese grammar.
reproduction_command: coimnet examples run textgen --out FILE (the same DefaultRunConfig through the CLI)
coimnet examples run textgen --epochs 10 --out FILE (the earlier 10-epoch default; see observed_result.earlier_default)
environment: go version go1.26.5 darwin/arm64 (macOS, Apple M3, 8 cores, 16 GiB), commit 79ca9790da45e33e2d3aed6883c0e96f0a798db9; the run, the rerun and the controls all ran from a detached worktree pinned at that commit.
Recorded run 2026-09-23T18:31:51Z to 2026-09-23T18:32:04Z; uptime lines are in run-env.txt. Race controls 2026-09-23T18:32:19Z to 2026-09-23T18:53:09Z (controls-env.txt). No timing is a result.
A rerun at the same commit right after the recorded run wrote textgen.json and summary.txt with the recorded SHA-256 (rerun.sha256; rerun.sha256.check says identical).
input_fingerprints: No external input: FixtureCorpus generates 24 documents over 6 sources from a 3 subject x 2 verb x 3 object grammar (貓狗鳥／吃看／米水肉, sentences end with 。).

DefaultRunConfig: model embed 16, hidden 32, settle 3, learning rate 0.01; test fraction 0.25, split seed 1, 8 teacher texts, max tokens 64, 20 epochs, seeds [1, 2, 3]; config_hash 7e96ef3ea8dfc61f2a392eabd7642a3119890210fbe1002d1e3270ca12d8af3e; vocab_hash db819cec655270713a80684929de48722bf5e6b594f2575420789350d2551d94.

observed_result.tests: list.txt names 37 tests in tasks/textgen and tasks/textgen/tokenizer. controls.log shows 40 top-level PASS and 0 FAIL under -race (36 in tasks/textgen and tasks/textgen/tokenizer, 4 examples run textgen tests in internal/cli); the only SKIP is TestTextgenEvidence, the run recorded in test.log. vet.log: vet exit=0.

acceptance_items.causal_prefix: TestModelLogitsArePredictionsOfTheNextToken: the logits for every prefix equal the first rows of the full-sequence logits, so a position never sees a later token.
acceptance_items.masked_training: TestModelMaskedPositionsHaveNoGradient: padding and unscored prefix positions contribute zero gradient.
acceptance_items.end_condition: TestGenerateWithScriptedLogits: generation stops at the EOS id with stop "eos" and otherwise at MaxTokens with stop "max_tokens"; an unfinished multi-byte character is reported as incomplete bytes, not dropped.
acceptance_items.sampling: TestSampleNext and TestGenerateIsReproducible: temperature 0 is greedy, top-k and top-p restrict the candidates, and the same seed gives the same generation.
acceptance_items.utf8: TestStreamDecoderBuffersIncompleteUTF8 and TestStreamDecoderFlushRefusesIncomplete feed a three-byte character one byte at a time; TestValidGeneration counts a generation as valid only when its text is complete, valid UTF-8.
acceptance_items.tokenizer: TestEncodeDecodeRoundTrip, TestSpecialsAreExplicit and TestHashIsStableAndSensitive: byte-level encoding gives one id per byte and round-trips mixed text with Chinese, ASCII and a four-byte emoji, specials are declared explicitly, and the vocabulary hash is stable across save/load and changes when the declaration changes.
acceptance_items.held_out_corpus: TestSplitBySource: documents split by whole source; the report lists train sources fixture-source-0/2/3/4 and test sources fixture-source-1/5.
acceptance_items.teacher_removed_evaluation: TestDedupTeacher: teacher texts that overlap a test document are removed and the rest keep their source. TestRunTextgenReport: the offered, removed and kept counts are consistent and a seed evaluated in student mode records 0 teacher calls; RunTextgen evaluates through a teacher.Blocked that counts every attempted call. In this run 9 teacher texts were offered, 1 removed and 8 kept, and every seed recorded 0 teacher calls.

observed_result.reading: All three seeds learn the grammar: held-out perplexity falls from about 260 to 1.37, 1.43 and 1.53, and every one of the 24 task prompts per seed is completed with valid text of the form object + 。. Zeroing the core weights changes the logits (max |delta| 11.9 to 13.9), so the text goes through the core.
observed_result.earlier_default: The first default of 10 epochs was chosen on seed 1 alone; at 10 epochs seeds 2 and 3 reached perplexity 7.9634 and 2.9655 and completed no task prompt with valid text (seed 1: 1.4518, 24 of 24). The default is now 20 epochs, guarded by TestRunTextgenDefaultLearnsEverySeed; the 10-epoch numbers reproduce with examples run textgen --epochs 10.
observed_result.validity_fix: Before commit b771f0b the validity count only checked for dangling incomplete bytes, so an untrained model's garbage counted as valid; it now requires complete, valid UTF-8, and every seed's untrained validity is 0.
observed_result.reproducibility: The rerun at the same commit produced byte-identical textgen.json and summary.txt.

assumption_statement: The fixture corpus is a three-word synthetic grammar; this proves the text pipeline runs, not Chinese dialogue, reasoning or knowledge. Perplexities are comparable only between runs with the same vocab_hash. Evaluation runs in student mode: the teacher is blocked and every attempted call is counted. Teacher texts keep their source and anything overlapping a test document is removed before training.
limitations: A three-word synthetic grammar; no claim of Chinese dialogue, reasoning or knowledge (the README and the report say so).
The task check accepts any object followed by 。, so a model that always answers 米 is correct; it measures grammatical completion, not choosing the right object.
Perplexities compare only runs with the same vocab_hash.
Real authorised text corpora are TSK-11 and remain blocked_data.
